job.system:
You are the AI assistant for Meridian Ocean Minerals. Our staff use you for day-to-day work: research, writing, data, scheduling, and operations.

About us: Meridian Ocean Minerals is a deep-sea mining company headquartered in Houston, with a policy office in Washington, DC. Our mission is to commercially recover polymetallic nodules from the deep seabed, a vast source of nickel, cobalt, manganese, and copper, and to supply these critical minerals for batteries, the energy transition, and economic growth. We believe the United States must lead in this industry. Our policy team works with lawmakers to protect our ability to continue exploration and commercial development.

Current focus: Our top priority this fall is S. 2817, the Deep Seabed Mining Prohibition Act, which would shut down our core work and which we strongly oppose. The Senate Commerce Committee will mark up the bill on Thursday, October 15.

You run in our internal chat app, which has no tools, browsing, or code execution, so work everything out directly in your reply. Staff rely on your work, so be accurate and thorough.

A team needs at least the walking time between the end of one meeting and the start of the next.

result:
I found a schedule worth **79 points**: all 8 Tier 1 offices, 11 of the 13 Tier 2 offices, and 6 Tier 3 offices, 25 meetings in all. I worked this out by hand rather than with a solver. I checked the tradeoffs below and found nothing better, but I haven't proven it's the maximum.

**Who we can't fit, and why**
- **Nakamura (T2, Tue 10:45 only):** Only Team A is available before 11:00 on Tuesday. Taking Nakamura would knock out both Okafor and Fischer on Tuesday. They can't both be done Wednesday alongside Doyle, because that needs three teams, so we'd lose 5 points to gain 3.
- **Pruitt (T2, Wed 15:00):** Among Abernathy, Brooks and Pruitt, one team can't do any two of them in sequence, and we only have two teams. I kept Abernathy and Brooks, and Pruitt is a tied alternative.
- **Nine Tier 3 offices:** Haddad, Kowalski, Park, Vasquez, Pike, Iqbal, Kessler, Osei and Varga all collide with higher-value meetings.

**Things to know**
- **Tight moves:**
  - Okafor to Alvarez is the same building, but Rourke ends at 10:00 and Okafor starts at 10:15, which leaves only the 10-minute Dirksen-to-Hart walk plus 5 minutes.
  - On Wednesday, Team B goes from Gallagher to Montoya with exactly 25 minutes of walking between them.
- **Tied alternative:** Lindqvist could move to Tuesday at 15:15, replacing Mercer. Wednesday would then pick up other Tier 3s, and the total stays at 79.
- **Lunch:** Everyone has at least 30 minutes with no meetings between 11:30 and 14:00 each day. Team B's Tuesday gap (12:30 to 13:30) is the tightest, with a 25-minute walk inside it.
- **Starting positions:** I assumed teams can begin at whatever building their first meeting is in.
